checked: Coffer Protocol (blockroad-doo): validators sell fixed-term ETH bonds against their stake, holders earn the yield; no keeper reward anywhere. Contracts (DefiLlama adapter FACTORY + factory getters I_COFFER_*_ADDRESS, all eth_getCode != 0x, getters answer): CofferFactory 0x619BE899317C58abEe3c0CE3c6D6A605221dD26f (verified Etherscan), only Coffer clone 0xDFFCb442a38B8ACA50927f3696AE5f44A75994a6, CofferRedemptionEscrow 0x9b5692caD80E9E5DC436Bbe6A30608D6240986d2, FeeCurve 0x067d43f306c90e4f3225a64ae0a9c1b633f3be2c, CofferBondNft 0x3e4A71A5D057C3E4e1f029dA3Bd1E373c2B7e223. Sources read: github blockroad-doo/coffer-smart-contracts src/Coffer.sol, FeeCurve.sol, CofferRedemptionEscrow.sol; marketplace repo deploy script is Hoodi-only. Functions eth_called from fresh address: holderRedeemBondOrDefault(1) reverts CallerIsNotHolder (caller must own the bond NFT - position, not a caller reward); holderRedeemBondInDefault same gate; declareDefault(1) callable by anyone, pays 0 (reverted HoldersTimeHasNotExpiredYet); exitValidator() callable by anyone while defaulted, pays 0 and the caller PAYS the EIP-7002 predeploy fee; escrow.claim(to) pays msg.sender's own pending claim (reverts NoPendingClaim); FeeCurve.claim() is permissionless but pays fixed feeRecipient 0xb5b0a1de34ebd56f5b807ec289e4094066b91db5, not the caller - pool sAccruedFees 0.015665 ETH ~ 27.26 USD, never claimed since launch.
